prior_quality_shift.note: predicted vs actual per-part IoU by predicted-score quintile; the gap between the two mean_actual columns at matched predicted scores is the prior-quality shift

arms.name: DINO-free shipped rule (VLM-box SAM, corrected alignment)

verdict: The DINO-free VLM-box SAM rule is shipped at 47.59 cIoU / 73.78 gIoU (no detector). The declared-trained detector-bearing recipe is 49.40/74.26; its substrate is detector-derived, so it is retained only as a labelled ablation. The detector-bearing training-free ablation is 50.34/74.69.

recipe_plus_combination_policy.spec: stratified-balanced re-weighting: weight(part) = (n_targeted_tune_refs / n_strata) / count(stratum) with the composition taken per ref from the tune records file (400 targeted refs: strata 1:259, 2:132, 3:4, 4:2, 5:1, 6:1, 11:1 -> base 400/7 = 57.14; per-part weights k=1 0.221, k=2 0.433, k=3 14.29, k=4 28.57, k=5/6/11 57.14), so each ref stratum carries equal total ref weight; realized over the 7,443 fit parts the stratum mass shares are 22.9 / 40.0 / 3.8 / 7.6 / 25.7% and the three rare refs with fit parts carry 37.1% of the fit mass (one k=5 ref alone 25.7%; strata 6, 11 and one k=3 ref have no parts in the table but count in the normalization) + within-row rank features + tau tuned on the held-out two-target stratum, + searched combination policy (unconditional top-1 SAM part, chosen on the held-out carve-out)

democracy.note: three fixed spatial questions per row, parts vote by geometry, top by (votes, prior); paired against the prior-only top part on the same rows; single-pick arms, so the absolute numbers sit below the shipped union rule

mechanism.hypothesis: population/composition mismatch between the train-side and val populations is the dominant cause of the transfer inversion
mechanism.measurement: train targeted rows: single-target 0.6833, two-target 0.3090; val targeted rows two-target 0.9953; mean parts per row 13.271 (train) vs 19.181 (val)
mechanism.verdict: MEASURED UNDER THE EARLIER ref_id-KEYED TERM MAP (provenance only): under per-record alignment the recipe no longer beats the training-free rule, so this mechanism account is withdrawn from the paper's conclusions.

mechanism.hypothesis: the learned prior is systematically miscalibrated on val (over-predicts part quality at high scores; the lowest val quintile under-predicts), so a train-tuned threshold admits too many parts
mechanism.measurement: mean predicted/actual: train 0.4269/0.4115, val 0.3658/0.3257; val calibration is monotone over-prediction at high scores
mechanism.verdict: MEASURED UNDER THE EARLIER ref_id-KEYED TERM MAP (provenance only): under per-record alignment the recipe no longer beats the training-free rule, so this mechanism account is withdrawn from the paper's conclusions.

decision_rule.pre_registered: ship the strata-{1,2}-only variant unless it is materially worse (>0.5 cIoU) than the all-strata recipe on the held-out two-target carve-out; stated before the ablation val numbers were seen
decision_rule.compared_pair: recipe-only held-out two-target cIoU, both arms policy-free (abs, k=0): 58.9004 vs 58.0895, gap 0.8109 > 0.5; the choice uses held-out numbers only, so no val information enters it; the policy-inclusive comparison (60.0462 vs 58.0895, gap 1.96) gives the same decision, so the outcome is robust to which pair is compared
decision_rule.val_gap_note: the val gap 52.7061 vs 51.9655 = 0.74 compares policy-free arms on the {1,2} side and a policy-inclusive arm on the all-strata side whose policy is a measured val no-op (52.7061 with and without), so the gap is not attributable to the policy

decomposition.note: single-correction ablations on the same frozen pipeline; the two-target threshold tuning is the dominant correction and the weightings alone collapse without it.  Composition per ref from the tune records file (400 targeted refs, 7 strata 1:259, 2:132, 3:4, 4:2, 5:1, 6:1, 11:1; base = 400/7 = 57.14).  Realized over the 7,443 fit parts: k=1 22.9%, k=2 40.0%, k=3 3.8%, k=4 7.6%, k=5 25.7% (k=6 and k=11 have no parts but count in the normalization).  Of the nine rare refs, six have parts (three in fit, three held-out) and three have none.
decomposition.reading: the correction that carries the transfer is tuning the acceptance threshold on the val-dominant two-target stratum; stratified weights add a smaller increment that is rare-ref dependent (three rare refs in the fit set carry 37.1% of the fit mass; the leave-one-out localizes the increment to the k4 fit ref, -0.95 when removed, while the k3 and k5 fit-ref masses are neutral -- see rare_ref_loo); weights without the stratum threshold are actively harmful. Leave-one-rare-ref-out (exp156, pre-registered as diagnostics only, no re-shipping): all seven refits land in 51.8273-52.8551 val cIoU, every one still above the training-free record (51.32) -- record-clearing is robust to any single rare ref (see rare_ref_loo)

rare_ref_loo.reading: record-clearing is robust to any single rare ref: all seven refits stay in 51.83-52.86 val cIoU, every one above the training-free record (51.32); worst case (k4 fit ref removed) is +0.51 over the record. The magnitude of the weight increment over tau-only (52.15) is NOT uniformly robust: it concentrates on the single k4 fit ref (removing it costs 0.95 and flips the held-out tau to 0.25, landing 0.32 below tau-only); the k3 and k5 fit-ref masses are neutral (+0.01, +0.002) and the composition/base perturbations move val by <= 0.14 (dropping a held-out rare ref from the composition alone slightly helps: +0.07 to +0.14)

alignment_correction.bug: gRefCOCO term lookups were keyed by ref_id, but a ref holds several sentences (14,229 val records over 4,237 ref_ids). 84.7% of targeted rows in multi-sentence refs used another sentence's noun terms; the same map was used by the term-path evaluation, the learned part tables and the studies.
alignment_correction.scope: exp118/exp124/exp138/exp152/exp163/exp169/exp177 gRefCOCO term paths; RefCOCO-family paths use each record's own sentence and are unaffected
alignment_correction.consequence: With per-record alignment the transfer-aware learned recipe (49.40 cIoU) no longer beats the training-free rule (49.63 cIoU). The earlier promotion (52.71 > 51.32) was an artifact of the misaligned terms and is withdrawn; the shipped gRefCOCO row reverts to the training-free rule. The earlier mechanism decomposition was measured on the same misaligned part tables and is retained only as provenance.
